caption: MCP Annotations
description: Optional annotations for the client. The client can use annotations to inform how objects are used or displayed Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 Annotations; 2026-07-28 Annotations).
name: mcp_annotations

mcp_audience.description:
MCP member `audience`: Describes who the intended audience of this object or data is.

It can include multiple entries to indicate content useful for multiple audiences (e.g., `["user", "assistant"]`).

mcp_last_modified.description:
MCP member `lastModified`: The moment the resource was last modified, as an ISO 8601 formatted string.

Should be an ISO 8601 formatted string (e.g., "2025-01-12T15:00:58Z").

Examples: last activity timestamp in an open file, timestamp when the resource
was attached, etc.

mcp_priority.description:
MCP member `priority`: Describes how important this data is for operating the server.

A value of 1 means "most important," and indicates that the data is
effectively required, while 0 means "least important," and indicates that
the data is entirely optional.

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
